goals.objective: Nexa desktop remediation continuation. Start from the existing working tree and preserve all user changes. Audit the current implementation and prior remediation evidence, then address remaining P0/P1 source-code, UI/UX, accessibility, reliability, security, maintainability, test-coverage, performance, documentation, and release-readiness gaps. Prioritize meaningful tests for critical main-process and async renderer behavior, fix defects revealed by those tests, improve responsive/keyboard/screen-reader behavior where evidence shows a gap, reconcile stale local docs and test counts, and keep dependencies unchanged unless essential. Do not alter product governance decisions such as direct provider access or the 98-tool policy without authority; record those as explicit external decisions. Verify with targeted tests, full lint/typecheck/unit tests, coverage, build, audit, E2E, packaging, and visual checks where locally possible. Windows-only behavior, real LiteLLM/Jira/Confluence integration, code signing, and organizational ownership remain documented external blockers unless locally verifiable. Maintain a complete durable journal in the ultragoal ledger and project wiki. Final completion requires an anti-slop pass, comprehensive code review approval, clean targeted/full verification, and a concise list of remaining external risks.
goals.evidence: Final remediation complete: 379 unit/integration tests, 15 Linux E2E with 2 Windows-only skips, 69.12% coverage, build/audits/package/fuses passed; code review APPROVE and architecture CLEAR. Journal in omx_wiki.
